# What should this plumbing job cost at a flat rate?

> True cost per hour, tiered parts markup, travel time and margin give a flat-rate price, a minimum callout and a time-and-materials comparison. Your numbers, not advice. No account, no upload.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/plumber-flat-rate-price-calculator/)
